She was later captured by Hank and/or his mind-controlled "workers," and turned into one of the workers herself using a [[brain-computer interface chip]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Other Player]]=== Rita, under mind control and dressed as an [[X-Branch office worker|office worker]], is seen working in the [[Las Vegas management Vault]] for Hank as part of the production line for more brain control chips. When [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] later comes to bring Hank to justice, Hank uses Rita as one of his examples to convince Lucy that his technology would benefit humanity. He notes that Rita makes an "excellent" trail mix, which is seen on her desk. '''Robert House's double''' is a man who served as the body double of the real [[Robert House]] before the [[Great War]]. He appears in both [[Fallout TV series season 1|season 1]] and [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==Background==
This man has been a close confidant of RobCo Industries founder [[Robert Edwin House]] since approximately [[Timeline#2067|2067]]. Similar-looking and similarly-dressed to the real Robert House, he is used by the real House for all public appearances, such as radio and television appearances, and to broadcast his thoughts to the general public, while maintaining anonymity and freedom of research. This man's image has become so closely associated with the real House that when Robert House himself appears in public, he is not widely recognized as the famous tycoon.<ref>{{FOTV|2|1}}</ref>

Together with [[Biff (TV series)|Ranger Biff]] and another veteran Ranger, the trio have been camped at an [[NCR outpost|outpost]] near [[Primm]] as of [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]].
